ValidationRule.description: Competitor Phones is selected as Other and there's nothing in Cancel Summary.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.ValidationSetting__c.ByPassAllValidationRules__c), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Competitor_Phones__c, "Other" ), ISCHANGED(Competitor_Phones__c) ), AND ( ISPICKVAL(Competitor_Software__c , "Other" ), ISCHANGED(Competitor_Software__c) )
), ISBLANK( Cancel_Summary__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You need to specify what the Competitor is using in the Cancel Summary!
